iraq.title: Flag of the Republic of Iraq

colors.note: The takbīr inscription in green Kufic script.

desc: - A horizontal tricolour of red, white, and black, charged with the takbīr (Allahu akbar, 'God is [the] greatest'
- ) in green Kufic script, centered on the white stripe. Adopted on 22 January 2008, replacing the three green stars
trivia:
- The three stars represent the unity of the Arab world, the Three Caliphates, or three historic regions
- The colours are Pan-Arab colours representing the Arab Revolt against Ottoman rule
- Iraq's flag has been modified several times to remove Saddam Hussein's added script after 2003

iraq-mandatory.title: Kingdom of Iraq under British administration
desc:
- The flag of Mandatory Iraq under British administration featured a black, white, and green horizontal triband with a red trapezoid at the hoist — the colours of the Arab Revolt that helped establish the state
- The Kingdom of Iraq adopted this flag in 1924 as part of British-arranged governance under the Hashemite monarchy
- **Construction:** three horizontal stripes of black (top), white, and green, with a red trapezoid at the hoist bearing two white seven-pointed stars
- Ratio approximately 1:2
trivia:
- Iraq was a British mandate from 1920 to 1932 after World War I
- The Union Jack represented British administrative authority
- Iraq gained nominal independence in 1932

iraq-hashemite.title: Hashemite Kingdom of Iraq
desc:
- The flag of the Hashemite Kingdom of Iraq (1924–1958) continued the Pan-Arab colour scheme with black, white, and green horizontal bands and a red trapezoid at the hoist
- This flag represented the Hashemite monarchy established by King Faisal I
- It was abandoned after the July 1958 revolution that overthrew the monarchy
- **Construction:** three horizontal stripes of black (top), white, and green with a red trapezoid at the hoist containing two white seven-pointed stars
- Ratio approximately 1:2

colors.note: Hashemite dynasty — the ruling family of the Kingdom.

trivia:
- The Hashemite kingdom of Iraq (1921–1958) was established by the British mandate
- Represented the Hashemite dynasty's rule in Iraq
- Overthrown in the 1958 Iraqi Revolution

iraq-republic.title: Iraqi Republic (Qasim era)
desc: - Post-monarchy flag after the 14 July Revolution with vertical tricolour
- **Construction:** three equal horizontal bands of red (top), white (middle), and black (bottom), with 'Allahu Akbar' in green Kufic script centred on the white band

colors.note: Revolution and the struggle for independence.

trivia:
- The Iraqi Republic (1958–1968) represented the period after the monarchy's overthrow
- The flag changed multiple times reflecting different political regimes
- Increasingly centralised power under Arab nationalist governments

iraq-baath.title: Iraqi Republic (Ba'athist)

colors.note: Takbir script; Islam and Arab identity.

desc:
- The Ba'athist-era flag featured a horizontal tricolour of red, white, and black with three green stars
- The stars were said to represent unity, freedom, and socialism. Used during Saddam Hussein's rule
- **Construction:** three equal horizontal bands of red, white, and black with three green five-pointed stars and 'Allahu Akbar' in green Kufic script centred on the white band
trivia:
- The Ba'ath Party ruled Iraq from 1963 to 2003 under Saddam Hussein
- The flag represented Ba'athist Arab nationalism and socialism
- Overthrown during the 2003 invasion
